query: What punishment can be given for violence during bandhs or strikes?
reference_answer:
Violence during Bandhs or Strikes:
Violence during bandhs or strikes can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the IPC Section 307 (attempt to murder) or Section 325 (grievous hurt).
answer: Violence during bandhs or strikes can lead to arrests and fines according to law. [Document 1]
